<translate>
'''Saibamen''' are the Saiyans' plant-grown soldiers. They sprout in [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]'s '''Rocky''' biome in six color variants, and a badly hurt Saibaman may grab you and blow itself up.
</translate>

<translate>
== Spawning ==

Saibamen spawn in the Rocky biome, in dim spots (block light 7 or less); about a third of spawn attempts succeed. The six variants spawn at different rates:
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Variants</translate> !! <translate>Spawn weight</translate> !! <translate>Group size</translate>
|-
| <translate>1 and 2</translate> || 80 / 70 || 2–4
|-
| <translate>3 and 4</translate> || 60 / 45 || 1–3
|-
| <translate>5 and 6</translate> || 35 / 25 || 1–2
|}

<translate>
== Behavior ==

Natural Saibamen fight on the '''Novice''' AI tier. Their health and damage above are their base values.

'''Self-destruct:''' when a Saibaman drops below 25% health, it has a small chance (5%) to latch onto its target's back and '''self-destruct''' 3 seconds later.
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops ==

Saibamen drop nothing.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==

The [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] quest '''Kill the Saibamen''' asks you to defeat 6 of them on Earth, and the [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] quest '''Saibamen Breakout''' sends 8 more at you in the Otherworld.
</translate>
